title.en: An Act Establishing a Regular District Office of the Land Transportation Office in the Municipality of Nabunturan, Compostela Valley Province and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a Regular District Office of the Land Transportation Office in the Municipality of Nabunturan, Compostela Valley Province and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Văn phòng Khu vực Chính quy Land Transportation Office tại Đô thị Nabunturan, Tỉnh Compostela Valley Province, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งสำนักงานเขตปกติ Land Transportation Office ในเทศบาล Nabunturan จังหวัด Compostela Valley Province และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Kantor Distrik Reguler Land Transportation Office di Kotamadya Nabunturan, Provinsi Compostela Valley Province, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Pejabat Daerah Biasa Land Transportation Office di Perbandaran Nabunturan, Wilayah Compostela Valley Province, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There shall be established a regular district office of the Land Transportation Office, hereinafter referred to as LTO Office, in Compostela Valley Province which shall exercise jurisdiction over all municipalities of the province.
The LTO Office shall be located in the Municipality of Nabunturan.

The Secretary of Transportation and Communications shall immediately include in the Department’s programs the operationalization of the LTO Office of Compostela Valley Province, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
